Weak/auxiliary sources were used only to corroborate or contextualize official facts: FinViewer for 2024 board-candidate disclosure feed, WBC for Oleg Alekseenkov CEO context, and professional speaker/database pages for Sergey Alekseenkov. Main conflict: Igor Martyshev's birth year differs between the local 2024 annual report (1971) and later 2025 materials/prospectus (1970); birth year was not used as a final structured fact. Search is considered complete because the relevant local PDFs were checked, official issuer/company disclosure, e-disclosure, professional biographies, academic profiles, government/business media and auxiliary disclosure feeds were reviewed, and two later search passes did not produce higher-quality sources for the remaining gaps. Round 3 (2026-07-19): Ran one additional targeted gap-fill research pass across all 10 EUTR people, focused only on fields already flagged null/uncertain after round 2 (education-entry graduation years, a handful of professional_experience GICS triples, and two honorary-title degree entries) -- already-confirmed facts were not re-verified from scratch.
